questions.question: Why should a Next.js App Router project use a makeStore() factory instead of exporting a single store instance from a module?
options: configureStore cannot run on the server
A module-level store is shared by all concurrent requests on the server, so one user's state can leak into another user's render
A singleton store disables Redux DevTools
questions.explanation: The server process is long-lived and handles many requests. A shared store is mutated by all of them, which leaks data between users. A per-request store avoids that.

questions.question: Inside the client StoreProvider, why is the store created inside `if (storeRef.current === null)` with useRef?
options: So the store is created once per component instance and not replaced on every re-render
Because useRef makes the store serialisable
So that the store is shared between all users on the server
questions.explanation: Calling makeStore() directly in the component body would create a new store, and lose all state, on every render. The ref keeps the first store for the component's lifetime.

questions.question: A Server Component calls useSelector from react-redux. What happens?
options: It reads the server-side store created for the request
Next.js converts it to a Client Component automatically
It throws an error saying the function is not supported in React Server Components
questions.explanation: React-Redux ships a react-server build whose hooks throw 'This function is not supported in React Server Components. Please only use this export in a Client Component.'

questions.question: A root layout (a Server Component) fetches the user's cart and renders <StoreProvider initialCart={cart}>. Which requirement applies to initialCart?
options: It must be wrapped in a Promise
It must be an Immer draft
It must be serialisable, such as plain objects, arrays, strings and numbers
It must be created with createEntityAdapter
questions.explanation: Props passed from a Server Component to a Client Component cross a network boundary and must be serialisable by React. Class instances and functions are not allowed.
